Title: Container insights recommended alerts (custom metrics) (preview) retirement moving up to 31 May 2024

Body.Content:
On March 2023, we announced Container insights recommended alerts (custom metrics) (preview) will be retired on 14 March 2026. Since the replacement offering is now in General Availability, we are moving up the retirement date to 31 May 2024 to ensure you are using the most reliable service to monitor your Kubernetes clusters. Reminder that the custom metrics powering these alerts will be retired as well. 

Required Action 

To avoid or minimize disruption to your monitoring workflows setup using the custom metric alert (preview) feature, please refer to migration guidance and take the recommended actions before 31 May 2024. You will not be able to onboard additional monitored Kubernetes clusters to this feature using Azure Portal.    

Help and support 

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support question and you need technical help, please create a support request.
